title: Monotonicity conjecture for the expected beta-content function
statement:
Let $d$ and $n$ be as in the beta-polytope model, and fix parameters $\beta_1,\ldots,\beta_n\geq -1$. Write $\mathscr{P}_{n,d}^{\beta_1,\ldots,\beta_n}$ for the corresponding beta polytope, and let $\operatorname{Cont}_\beta$ denote its beta-content function. **Monotonicity conjecture.** The function

$$
\beta\longmapsto \mathbb{E}\operatorname{Cont}_\beta(\mathscr{P}_{n,d}^{\beta_1,\ldots,\beta_n})
$$

is increasing in $\beta$. The conjecture concerns the probability that a beta-distributed point is a vertex; the preceding discussion identifies the limiting cases $\beta=-1$ and $\beta\to+\infty$, but does not establish the asserted monotonicity.
references:
**2 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2025). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:2501.00671](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.00671).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.22488

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of March 2025).
source_name: Zakhar Kabluchko and David Albert Steigenberger, “Beta Polytopes and Beta Cones: An Exactly Solvable Model in Geometric Probability”, arXiv:2503.22488 (2025).
